newsitem.title: MALAYSIA: KL tin ends down four cents, tracks London's fall.
newsitem.headline: KL tin ends down four cents, tracks London's fall.

text.p: Malaysia's tin price ended down four cents at 14.60 ringgit ($5.77) a kg, as the local market tracked a $50 drop on the London Metal Exchange (LME) on Friday, traders said.
Traders noted initial bids for 56 tonnes against offers for 82 tonnes. Final turnover was 72 tonnes, against 70 on Friday, and were again taken up by European and Malaysian buyers.
Traders pegged immediate support at 14.50 ringgit.
The local price premium over the LME widened to $200 a tonne against $175 previously, the traders said.
